faqs: Do you design and fit in Grantham?
Yes. Grantham is about 30 miles from our workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes up the A1, and we cover Great Gonerby, Barrowby, Harlaxton and Londonthorpe too.
What works best in a Victorian or Edwardian terrace?
Fitted alcove wardrobes, kitchen storage that uses the full height of the wall and under-stairs cupboards usually turn narrow rooms into practical ones.
How do you split up a large open-plan kitchen-diner?
Often with an island or a bank of tall units between the cooking and living areas, sometimes with a matching media wall. We’ll show you the options in 3D.
How much is a fitted kitchen?
Straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000. Larger kitchens with islands, premium worktops and appliances cost more. The itemised quote after your free survey shows everything.
Can I see examples of your kitchens?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, about 40 minutes from Grantham. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a visit.
